title: Target main and include Pages updates for research-result pull requests
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 3 instruction that, unless there is a specific reason or an explicit exception, every research result must be submitted as a pull request directly against main and must include the corresponding GitHub Pages updates so that the result can be published after merge. A Pages preview must remain distinct from production publication. This instruction does not itself authorize merging a pull request, deploying Pages, changing scientific Consensus, or publishing confidential information.
